title: Display "last loop" time from OpenAPS
body: It would be very helpful if xDrip would display the "last loop" time from OpenAPS when available. In particular, I'd love to see how many minutes it has been since the last completed loop.

comments.body: This is already in development. See https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/868#issuecomment-493463973 for example.
